name: When should I get a Luxury Condo CMA?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a Luxury Condo CMA?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should get a Luxury Condo CMA when you are considering selling your property, refinancing, or even appealing your property taxes. It's also beneficial to obtain one periodically to understand your asset's value in a dynamic market. For instance, in high-demand areas like Miami Beach or Fort Lauderdale Beach, market conditions can shift, impacting property values. Preparing for a potential sale with an up-to-date CMA ensures your listing price is competitive and attractive to buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Obtain a Luxury Condo CMA when considering selling, refinancing, appealing property taxes, or periodically to monitor your asset's value, especially in active markets.
